## EDA

Look at number of plots per participant

<!-- # ```{r} -->
<!-- # all_data |>  -->
<!-- #   # filter(!is.na(lineup_order)) |>  -->
<!-- #   # filter(recruited != "I am the researcher") |> -->
<!-- #   # count(prolific_id, participant_id) |> -->
<!-- #   # count(participant_id) |> -->
<!-- #   count(prolific_id) |> -->
<!-- #   # arrange(-n) |>  -->
<!-- #   DT::datatable() -->
<!-- # ``` -->

```{r}
# all_data_orig |>
#   count(participant_id) |>
#   DT::datatable(rownames = F)
```

```{r}
all_data_clean |>
  count(participant_id) |>
  DT::datatable(rownames = F)
```

Look at number of replications per treatment

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  count(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

Look at number of participants per version x treatment

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  count(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0)) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

Plot of all of that...

```{r}
all_data_clean |>
  count(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  complete(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  arrange(-n) |> 
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0)) |> 
  filter(theta != "0") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             y = n, 
             fill = version)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat     = "identity", 
           position = "stack") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       y = "",
       title = "Number of Participants who evaluated the lineup",
       subtitle = str_c("By ", "<span style = 'color:#1B9E77'>**version A**</span>", " and ", 
       "<span style = 'color:#D95F02'>**version B**</span>")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 12),
        legend.position = "none"
        )
```

Look at correctness

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
  mutate(correct = factor(correct)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             fill = correct)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat     = "count", 
           position = "stack") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       y = "",
       title = str_c("Number of Participants who ", "<span style = 'color:#1F87B4'>**correctly**</span>", " and ", 
       "<span style = 'color:#A6CEE3'>**incorrectly**</span>", "<br> identified the target panel")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14),
        legend.position = "none"
        )
```

```{r}
all_data_clean |> 
  select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
  # complete(version, cpLoc, sigma, theta) |>
  mutate(correct = factor(correct)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             fill = correct)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat     = "count", 
           position = "fill") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       y = "",
       title = str_c("Proportion of Participants who ", "<span style = 'color:#1F87B4'>**correctly**</span>", " and ", 
       "<span style = 'color:#A6CEE3'>**incorrectly**</span>", "<br> identified the target panel")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14),
        legend.position = "none"
        )
```

```{r}
all_data_clean |>
  select(participant_id, version, cpLoc, sigma, theta, correct, response_no, obs_plot_location) |> 
  group_by(cpLoc, sigma, theta) |> 
  summarize(prop_correct = sum(correct)/n()) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = theta, 
             y = prop_correct)
         ) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           fill = "#1F87B4") +
  facet_grid(sigma ~ cpLoc, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Theta \n(Mean Shift + Direction)",
       y = "",
       title = str_c("Proportion of Participants who ", "<span style = 'color:#1F87B4'>**correctly**</span>", " identified the target panel")
       ) + 
  theme(plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14)
        )
```

## Binomial GLMM

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)

mod <- glmer(correct ~ theta + sigma + cpLoc + theta:sigma + theta:cpLoc + (1 | participant_id),
             family = binomial(),
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 20000)
             ),
             data = all_data_clean
             )

mod <- glmer(correct ~ theta*sigma*cpLoc + (1 | participant_id),
             family = binomial(),
             control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                                    optCtrl   = list(maxfun = 20000)
             ),
             data = all_data_clean
             )

summary(mod)

mod <- glmer(correct ~ (1 |theta) + (1 | sigma) + (1|cpLoc) + (1|theta:sigma) + (1|theta:cpLoc)  + (1 | participant_id),
             family = binomial(),
             data = all_data_clean
             )

summary(mod)
mod |> profile() |> confint()

mod_glm <- glm(correct ~ theta*sigma*cpLoc + participant_id,
             family = binomial(),
             data = all_data_clean
             )

mod <- glm(correct ~ theta*sigma*cpLoc + lineup_id,
             family = binomial(),
             data = all_data_clean
             )

mod <- glm(correct ~ theta*sigma*cpLoc + participant_id + lineup_id,
             family = binomial(),
             data = all_data_clean
             )

aov(mod_glm) |> 
  summary()


car::Anova(mod)
anova(mod)
estimates <- emmeans(mod, ~ theta:sigma:cpLoc, type = "response")
estimates 
  
```
